$comment: The shop counter itself is an event (crownspire_shop, in data/events/crownspire_provisioner.json) because it has to open a shop. NOTE FOR WHOEVER OWNS data/items/shops.json: this counter currently opens the shop id "aureline_provisioner", because shops.json is not this build's file and six agents are writing to it at once. Crownspire wants a row of its own -- id "crownspire_provisioner", a name like Corrow and Bell, and rope, canvas and cold-weather stock -- and switching to it is one string in that event file.

lines: Second counter is rope, canvas, oil and lamp wick, and three of those are nearly gone.
Nobody is buying them to climb with. They are buying them to tie their roofs down.
The Frostmere order has not come. Eleven years I have taken that order in on a Tuesday.
The carter got as far as the pass and turned round, and he is not a man who turns round.
Thawcloth. All of it. Whatever you have got.
Not for me. For whatever is going to be sitting in the plaza tomorrow morning.
In my day you bought your rope from the market and your medicine from the clinic,
and both of them were free, and one of them still is. Work out which. Go on.
